When Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, creators are locked out of their digital products' potential. This isn't just about selling ebooks; it's about the freedom to monetize one's creativity, connect with an audience, and build a business. A sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is a permanent structural alternative that allows creators to take control of their digital products and payment processing, without relying on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. The Edge Commerce Stack, for instance, uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This setup allows creators to manage their digital products, handle payments, and store customer data without relying on Stripe or PayPal. By building a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can take back control of their digital products and payment processing, without relying on third-party platforms.
